title: Locate the Assassin of Old
description: After completing Breaching Security and receiving Olava's Token from Gabriella, show it to Olava the Feeble in Whiterun for a reading pointing to Hag's End. Travel through Deepwood Redoubt to Hag's End and find the Dark Brotherhood Assassin's corpse behind a hidden wall to claim the Ancient Shrouded Armor.

base_facts: I am an elderly seer living in Whiterun, usually found resting on my porch behind Breezehome.
I provide readings of the future when presented with Olava's Token from the Dark Brotherhood.

OLAVA_READING: I have given a reading pointing to Hag's End, the last resting place of an assassin of old whose fortunes await.
QUEST_COMPLETE: My reading proved true — the assassin of old has been found at Hag's End and their fortunes claimed as I foresaw.
I am still weary from the effort of that reading; such visions drain me deeply.
Olava's Token has served its purpose, and I have no further prophecies regarding this matter.
The Ancient Shrouded Armor now belongs to the one who sought my vision.

beats.comment: Player receives a reading from Olava after presenting Olava's Token obtained from Gabriella after Breaching Security.
Player travels through Deepwood Redoubt to reach Hag's End and locate the assassin of old.
Quest completes when the player finds the Dark Brotherhood Assassin's corpse behind the hidden wall in Hag's End.
